caseTitle.en: The red light on the steriliser

tagline.zh: 看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨
tagline.en: Looking clean is not the same as being clean

desc.zh: 感控輪訓的一天。你每天用的器械，今天從另一頭看：髒的怎麼變成無菌的。
desc.en: An infection-control rotation day. The instruments you use daily, seen from the other end: how dirty becomes sterile.

desc.zh: 清洗、檢查、包裝、滅菌、監測、放行。每一包都有妳的名字，也有一個鍋次號碼。
desc.en: Clean, inspect, pack, sterilise, monitor, release. Every pack carries your name and a load number.

role.zh: 牙科主治兼感控委員（師傅）

about.zh: 當了十年感控委員，白袍口袋插著一支生物指示劑。口頭禪：「看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨。」
about.en: Ten years on the infection-control committee; a biological indicator clipped in her coat pocket. Catchphrase: 'Looking clean is not being clean.'

about.zh: 看一眼包裝就知道是誰包的。唯一的規矩：手機不准進清潔區。
about.en: Can tell who packed a tray at a glance. One rule: no phones in the clean zone.

about.zh: 入行第二年，手很快。今天早上太快了，雙手回套了一支用過的麻醉針。
about.en: Second year in the job, very quick hands. Too quick this morning: she recapped a used anaesthetic needle with both hands.

about.zh: 第一胎。牙齦一刷就流血，蛀牙一直不敢處理，因為婆婆說「懷孕不能看牙」。
about.en: First baby. Gums bleed whenever she brushes, and she's left a cavity alone because her mother-in-law says 'no dentist in pregnancy'.

about.zh: 只在電話裡。每一個事件她都會問同一句：「什麼時候、誰、哪一包？」
about.en: Only on the phone. For every incident she asks the same thing: 'When, who, which pack?'

about.zh: 診間的電話。打來的時候，背景通常有吸唾管的聲音。
about.en: The clinic phone. When she rings, there's usually a suction tip gurgling in the background.

plain.zh: 用過的器械變回可以再用的整個流程：預清、清洗、檢查、包裝、滅菌、監測、儲存。少一步都不行。
plain.en: The whole chain that makes a used instrument safe again: pre-clean, wash, inspect, pack, sterilise, monitor, store. No step can be skipped.

plain.zh: 像大型洗碗機，用清潔劑和熱水把器械上的血、唾液、組織洗掉。洗不乾淨的東西，滅菌也滅不透。
plain.en: Like a big dishwasher: detergent and hot water strip blood, saliva and tissue from instruments. What isn't clean can't be reliably sterilised.

plain.zh: 用高溫高壓的蒸氣殺死所有微生物，包括細菌芽孢。牙科手機也要這樣滅菌，不能只擦拭。
plain.en: High-temperature, pressurised steam that kills all microorganisms including bacterial spores. Dental handpieces are sterilised this way too, never just wiped.

plain.zh: 包裝上會變色的貼條。變色只代表「有經過滅菌條件」，不代表一定無菌。
plain.en: A strip on the pack that changes colour. It shows the pack was exposed to the process, not that it is definitely sterile.

plain.zh: 裝著耐熱細菌芽孢的小管，跟著一鍋一起滅菌再拿去培養。長不出來才證明真的有殺死。
plain.en: A small vial of heat-resistant bacterial spores sterilised with the load and then incubated. Only if nothing grows is the kill proven.

plain.zh: 每天第一鍋前做的測試，檢查滅菌鍋能不能把空氣抽乾淨、讓蒸氣均勻穿透。
plain.en: A test run before the first load each day to check the steriliser removes air properly so steam penetrates evenly.

plain.zh: 每一包都有鍋次號碼，記錄用在哪一位病人。出問題時才知道要找回哪些、通知誰。
plain.en: Every pack carries a load number recorded against the patient it was used on. When something goes wrong, you know what to retrieve and whom to tell.

plain.zh: 某一鍋的監測不合格時，把那一鍋（和上次合格之後）的器械全部找回來重新處理，並評估已經用過的病人。
plain.en: When a load fails monitoring, every item from that load (and since the last good test) is brought back and reprocessed, and patients already treated are assessed.

plain.zh: 被用過的針或尖銳器械刺傷。可能感染 B 肝、C 肝、愛滋，要立刻處理和通報。
plain.en: Being pricked by a used needle or sharp. It can transmit hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV, so it is handled and reported immediately.

plain.zh: 被針扎後依風險給的預防性藥物或疫苗。越早評估越好，所以不能等到下班才說。
plain.en: Medicine or vaccine given after an exposure according to the risk. The earlier the assessment the better, which is why it can't wait until the end of the day.

plain.zh: 懷孕時荷爾蒙讓牙齦對牙菌斑反應更大，容易紅腫流血。好好清潔和洗牙就會改善。
plain.en: Pregnancy hormones make the gums overreact to plaque, so they swell and bleed easily. Good cleaning and a scale and polish help.

plain.zh: 血糖太低：冒冷汗、發抖、心跳快、說話不清楚，嚴重會昏迷。糖尿病人空腹看牙特別容易發生。
plain.en: Blood sugar too low: sweating, trembling, racing heart, slurred speech, and in severe cases coma. Common in diabetics who come to the dentist fasting.

text.zh: 器械打開關節、平放在架子上。疊在一起的地方，水洗不到。
text.en: Instruments opened at the joints and laid flat on racks. Where they're stacked, the water can't reach.

text.zh: 每一鍋都會印出溫度、壓力、時間的紀錄。紙條跟鍋次號碼一起歸檔。
text.en: Every cycle prints a record of temperature, pressure and time, filed with the load number.

text.zh: 滅菌過的指示劑和一支沒滅菌的對照組一起放進去。對照組要長，測試組要不長，才算數。
text.en: The processed indicator goes in with an unprocessed control. The control must grow and the test must not, or the result doesn't count.

text.zh: 日期、鍋號、包裝者、效期。阿慧說：「出事的時候，這一張比任何人說的話都可靠。」
text.en: Date, load number, packer, expiry. A-hui says: 'When something goes wrong, this label beats anyone's memory.'

name.zh: 看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨
name.en: Looking clean is not being clean

text.zh: 器械上的血和唾液乾掉後會保護細菌，所以滅菌之前一定先清洗乾淨。化學指示劑變色只代表包裹經過了滅菌條件；真正證明有殺死芽孢的是生物指示劑。物理紀錄、化學指示劑、生物指示劑三種監測都過了，才放行。
text.en: Dried blood and saliva shield bacteria, so cleaning always comes before sterilisation. A changed chemical indicator only shows the pack went through the process; proof that spores were killed comes from the biological indicator. Release only when physical records, chemical and biological indicators all pass.

text.zh: 用肥皂和流動清水沖洗傷口，不要擠、不要刷、不要用漂白水；立刻通報；記錄器械與來源病人；在同意下檢驗來源病人；依 B 肝抗體、來源風險評估暴露後預防，越早越好。預防比處理容易：用過的針單手回套或直接丟銳器盒。
text.en: Wash with soap and running water, no squeezing, scrubbing or bleach; report at once; record the device and the source patient; test the source patient with consent; assess post-exposure prophylaxis by hepatitis B immunity and source risk, as early as possible. Prevention is easier: one-handed recapping or straight into the sharps bin.

name.en: Pregnancy is no reason to skip the dentist

text.zh: 懷孕時口腔照護是安全而且建議的，中期最舒服。牙周發炎和蛀牙不處理，疼痛與感染對媽媽和寶寶都不好。必要的 X 光經過正當化、用最低劑量並戴甲狀腺護領；局部麻醉一般劑量是安全的。後期躺著看牙要稍微左側傾斜。
text.en: Dental care in pregnancy is safe and recommended, the middle trimester being most comfortable. Untreated gum disease and decay mean pain and infection for mother and baby. Necessary X-rays are justified, kept to the lowest dose, with a thyroid collar; local anaesthetic at usual doses is safe. Late in pregnancy, tilt her slightly left in the chair.

note.zh: 今天從器械的另一頭看
note.en: Seeing instruments from the other end

lines.zh: 今天你不看病人，你看器械。你每天用的口鏡，從這裡出發。
lines.en: No patients for you today; you follow instruments. Every mirror you use starts its day here.

lines.zh: 手機放置物櫃。進清潔區之前，手洗乾淨、衣服換好。
lines.en: Phone in the locker. Before the clean zone: hands washed, gown changed.

lines.zh: 記一句：看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨。
lines.en: Remember one line: looking clean is not being clean.

guide.en: The test before the first load

lines.zh: 波威-迪克測試跑完了，測試紙顏色均勻，滅菌鍋今天可以用。紀錄貼進本子。
lines.en: Bowie-Dick test done; the sheet has changed colour evenly, so the steriliser is good for today. Record pasted into the log.

lines.zh: 顏色不均勻的那天，整天都不能開鍋。
lines.en: On a day it comes out patchy, nothing goes in all day.

lines.zh: 一支用過的牙科手機，到下一位病人嘴裡之前，經過哪幾站？
lines.en: A used dental handpiece, before it reaches the next patient's mouth: which stations does it pass?

q.zh: 牙科器械再處理的順序

steps.en: Release and store once monitoring passes

post.zh: 手機不能只用酒精擦。裡面的管路會吸回唾液，一定要清洗、上油、滅菌。
post.en: Handpieces are never just wiped with alcohol. Their internal lines suck back saliva; they're cleaned, oiled and sterilised.

lines.zh: 這支探針洗過了，看起來很乾淨。
lines.en: This explorer's been washed. It looks perfectly clean.

lines.zh: 放大鏡下面看看關節那裡。
lines.en: Look at the joint under the magnifier.

lines.zh: 放大後，尖端與握柄的接縫裡卡著一點乾掉的褐色殘渣。退回重洗。
lines.en: Magnified, a fleck of dried brown residue sits in the seam between tip and handle. Back for rewashing.

lines.zh: 看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨。
lines.en: Looking clean is not being clean.

sub.zh: 牙科助理被用過的針扎到

lines.zh: 小婷回套麻醉針時被扎到了，她說病人看起來很健康，想做完今天再說。她現在走去供應中心找你們。
lines.en: Hsiao-ting got stuck recapping an anaesthetic needle. She says the patient looks healthy and wants to finish the day first. She's walking over to you now.

lines.zh: 我擠了很多血出來，用酒精刷過了。病人很健康，應該沒事吧？
lines.en: I squeezed loads of blood out and scrubbed it with alcohol. The patient looks healthy, so it's fine, isn't it?

lines.zh: 你跟她說，現在要做什麼？
lines.en: You tell her: what now?

q.zh: 被用過的麻醉針扎到，接下來？
q.en: Stuck by a used anaesthetic needle: what next?

options.zh: 肥皂清水沖、立刻通報、驗來源病人
options.en: Soap and water, report now, test the source

why.zh: 對。不擠不刷，沖洗後立刻通報；在同意下驗來源病人；依她的 B 肝抗體與風險評估暴露後預防，越早越好。
why.en: Right. No squeezing or scrubbing; wash, then report immediately; test the source patient with consent; assess post-exposure prophylaxis by her hepatitis B immunity and the risk, as early as possible.

options.zh: 看起來健康就不用通報
options.en: Patient looks healthy; no need to report

why.zh: B 肝、C 肝、愛滋都看不出來。不通報就沒有檢驗，也沒有預防。
why.en: Hepatitis B, C and HIV don't show on the outside. No report, no testing, no prophylaxis.

options.zh: 做完今天的病人再通報

why.zh: 暴露後預防有時間窗，越早越好。來源病人可能也已經離開了。
why.en: Prophylaxis has a time window; earlier is better. And the source patient may have gone home by then.

post.en: ...I thought squeezing it out was better.

post.zh: 很多人都這樣以為。用過的針，下次單手回套或直接丟銳器盒。
post.en: Plenty of people think so. Next time, recap one-handed or straight into the sharps bin.

note.zh: 林太太：懷孕中期，正是看牙的時候
note.en: Mrs Lin: mid-pregnancy, just the right time

lines.zh: 婆婆說懷孕不能看牙，可是我刷牙一直流血，右下那顆也會酸。
lines.en: My mother-in-law says no dentist in pregnancy, but my gums bleed every time I brush, and the lower right tooth aches.

lines.zh: 懷孕中期正是看牙最舒服的時候。先看牙齦，再看那顆牙。
lines.en: Mid-pregnancy is actually the most comfortable time for dental care. Gums first, then that tooth.

post.zh: 牙齦紅腫、一碰就流血，牙周囊袋不深。妊娠期牙齦炎。
post.en: Gums red and swollen, bleeding at a touch, pockets shallow. Pregnancy gingivitis.

guide.zh: 孕婦要不要照 X 光

lines.zh: 要照 X 光？對寶寶會不會不好？
lines.en: An X-ray? Is that bad for the baby?

lines.zh: 你回答她：照不照、照什麼、怎麼保護？
lines.en: You answer her: whether, which film, and how we protect her?

lines.zh: 只照右下一張咬翼片，戴甲狀腺護領。看鄰接面蛀到哪裡。
lines.en: Just one right-side bitewing, with a thyroid collar. To see how deep the cavity between the teeth goes.

question.zh: 孕婦的咬翼片：為什麼可以照、照完看什麼？
question.en: A bitewing in pregnancy: why is it acceptable, and what do you look for?

answer.zh: 有臨床需要（會酸、懷疑鄰接面齲齒）就算正當化；一張咬翼片劑量極低，再戴甲狀腺護領、只照需要的那一側。看齲齒有沒有穿過琺瑯質進到牙本質、離牙髓多遠，決定是修補還是先觀察。
answer.en: A clinical need (sensitivity, suspected decay between teeth) justifies it; one bitewing is a tiny dose, with a thyroid collar and only the side needed. Look at whether the decay has passed through enamel into dentine and how close it is to the pulp, to decide between filling and watching.

post.zh: 右下第一大臼齒咬合面的蛀洞進到牙本質，離牙髓還有距離。
post.en: The decay in the lower right first molar's biting surface reaches dentine, still clear of the pulp.

lines.zh: 只去掉蛀的地方，沿著窩溝走，不要為了好補而多磨。
lines.en: Remove only the decay, follow the fissures, and don't cut extra just to make filling easier.

lines.zh: 麻藥對寶寶沒關係嗎？
lines.en: Is the anaesthetic all right for the baby?

lines.zh: 一般劑量的局部麻醉是安全的，痛反而對妳和寶寶都不好。
lines.en: Local anaesthetic at the usual dose is safe; pain is worse for both of you.

lines.zh: 蛀的牙本質清乾淨了嗎？邊緣在哪裡停？
lines.en: Is the carious dentine cleared? Where do the margins stop?

post.zh: 就這樣？我還以為要躺一個下午。回家跟婆婆說，懷孕可以看牙。
post.en: That's it? I thought I'd be lying here all afternoon. I'm telling my mother-in-law: pregnant women can see the dentist.

lines.zh: 林太太那盤器械回來了：關節打開、平放、進清洗消毒機。手機拔下來另外處理。
lines.en: Mrs Lin's tray is back: joints opened, laid flat, into the washer-disinfector. The handpiece comes off for separate processing.

lines.zh: 妳放得比上個月平。
lines.en: You lay them flatter than last month.

name.en: The red light on the incubator

note.zh: 第三鍋的生物指示劑陽性
note.en: Load three's biological indicator is positive

lines.zh: 早上第三鍋的生物指示劑亮紅燈。對照組也有長，所以結果是真的。
lines.en: The biological indicator from this morning's load three is showing red. The control grew too, so it's a real result.

q.zh: 點一下培養箱，確認是哪一鍋的指示劑陽性
q.en: Tap the incubator and confirm which load's indicator is positive

lines.zh: 第三鍋的包裝上，化學指示劑都有變色。你怎麼處理？
lines.en: The chemical indicators on load three's packs all changed colour. What do you do?

q.zh: 生物指示劑陽性，化學指示劑有變色？
q.en: Biological indicator positive, chemical indicators changed?

options.zh: 停用該鍋、召回整鍋、通知感控
options.en: Steriliser out, recall the load, tell infection control

why.zh: 對。生物指示劑才是證明。停用滅菌鍋檢修，召回上次合格之後的器械重新處理，用追溯紀錄找出已經用過的病人。
why.en: Right. The biological indicator is the proof. Take the steriliser out of service, recall everything since the last good test for reprocessing, and use the tracking record to find patients already treated.

options.zh: 化學指示劑變色了，應該沒問題
options.en: Chemical indicators changed, so it's fine

why.zh: 化學指示劑只代表有經過條件，不代表芽孢被殺死。
why.en: A chemical indicator shows exposure to the process, not that spores were killed.

why.zh: 鍋子本身可能有問題，再跑一次也不可靠；而且已經發出去的包不會自己回來。
why.en: The steriliser itself may be faulty, so a rerun proves nothing; and packs already issued won't come back on their own.

post.zh: 工程師說門封條有一段漏氣，蒸氣進不到最裡面。
post.en: The engineer says a section of the door seal leaks; steam couldn't reach the back.

lines.zh: 第三鍋一共二十包，十六包還在無菌庫房，四包已經發到診間，其中三包用過了。
lines.en: Traceability says load three had twenty packs. Sixteen still in the sterile store, four issued to clinics, three of those already used.

lines.zh: 用過的三包對到兩位病人，名單傳給鄭護理師。
lines.en: The three used packs match two patients; list sent to Nurse Cheng.

note.en: A fasting diabetic after an extraction

sub.zh: 拔牙後病人冒冷汗、說話不清
sub.en: After an extraction: sweaty, slurred speech

lines.zh: 六十歲先生，有糖尿病，早上打了胰島素，怕拔牙沒吃早餐。現在冒冷汗、手抖、說話不清楚，還醒著。
lines.en: A man of sixty, diabetic, took his insulin this morning but skipped breakfast before the extraction. Now sweaty, shaky, slurred, still awake.

options.zh: 測血糖；清醒能吞就給糖、呼叫
options.en: Check sugar; if awake and swallowing, sugar; call

why.zh: 對。依流程：清醒、能吞嚥就口服快速糖，再測一次；意識變差就呼叫急救、依醫囑處理。治療暫停。
why.en: Right. Per protocol: awake and able to swallow, fast-acting oral sugar and recheck; if consciousness drops, call the emergency team and treat per protocol. Treatment paused.

options.zh: 可能是緊張，讓他躺著休息
options.en: Probably nerves; let him lie down

why.zh: 空腹加胰島素加冒冷汗說話不清，先當低血糖。休息不會讓血糖回來。
why.en: Fasting, insulin, sweating and slurring: treat as hypoglycaemia first. Rest won't bring the sugar back.

options.zh: 讓他自己開車回家吃飯
options.en: Let him drive home to eat

why.zh: 低血糖開車是危險的。先處理、確認恢復，再安排回家。
why.en: Driving while hypoglycaemic is dangerous. Treat, confirm recovery, then arrange the journey home.

post.zh: 喝了果汁，十幾分鐘後再測，回來了。他說下次一定先吃早餐。
post.en: He had juice; rechecked a little later and he's back up. He says he'll eat breakfast next time.

sub.zh: 鄭護理師：第三鍋與小婷
sub.en: Nurse Cheng: load three and Hsiao-ting

lines.zh: 第三鍋用過的兩位病人，器械都有先清洗，風險評估很低；依政策明天由主治親自說明。
lines.en: The two patients from load three: the instruments were cleaned first, so the assessed risk is very low; per policy the attending will explain to them in person tomorrow.

lines.zh: 小婷的來源病人檢驗都陰性，她的 B 肝抗體也夠。追蹤照流程。
lines.en: Hsiao-ting's source patient tested negative, and her hepatitis B antibodies are adequate. Follow-up as per protocol.

lines.zh: 早上你說做完病人再通報。差一點，來源病人就回家了，抽不到血。
lines.en: This morning you said report after the patients. The source patient nearly went home before we could take blood.

lines.zh: 針扎是現在的事，不是下班的事。
lines.en: A needlestick is a now thing, not an end-of-day thing.

lines.zh: 你本來說看起來健康就不用通報。是鄭護理師在走廊攔下小婷的。
lines.en: You said a healthy-looking patient meant no report. It was Nurse Cheng who caught Hsiao-ting in the corridor.

lines.zh: 病毒看不出來。每一針都通報。
lines.en: You can't see a virus. Every stick gets reported.

guide.en: Dr Mo asks about the load

lines.zh: 如果照你說的放行，下午又會多發出十六包。
lines.en: If we'd released it your way, sixteen more packs would have gone out this afternoon.

lines.zh: 變色只代表經過，不代表殺死。我記住了。
lines.en: Colour change means exposed, not killed. I've got it.

lines.zh: 今天你沒看幾個病人，可是保護了很多人：小婷、林太太、兩位要被通知的病人，還有明天每一個躺上椅子的人。
lines.en: You saw hardly any patients today, yet you protected a lot of people: Hsiao-ting, Mrs Lin, the two patients we'll inform, and everyone who sits in a chair tomorrow.

lines.zh: 看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨。
lines.en: Looking clean is not being clean.

lines.zh: 值班未完。換了新門封條的滅菌鍋正在跑測試，培養箱裡，一支新的指示劑在等明天的答案。
lines.en: The night goes on. The steriliser, new door seal fitted, runs its test cycle; in the incubator a fresh indicator waits for tomorrow's answer.

sub.zh: 看起來乾淨，不等於乾淨
sub.en: Looking clean is not being clean
